identity.author: Bedrock-OSS (Nusiq, stirante, SirLich, and contributors)
identity.description: An Add-on Compiler for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition. Copies a project's RP/BP into com.mojang while running a configurable chain of filters that transform files non-destructively.

constraints: Requires attribution: MIT requires retaining the copyright notice
Repository also ships a second LICENSE.rtf; both were treated as consistent MIT grants per GitHub's own license detection

scripts: Go CLI compiler; filters are external processes/scripts run per project profile

customCapabilities.project_structure: single project folder holding RP/BP/config outside of com.mojang, compiled by a filter chain
customCapabilities.ecosystem: standard-library filters (Bedrock-OSS/regolith-filters) plus custom/proprietary filters in any language

manifestEvidence: README: Add-on Compiler for Minecraft Bedrock Edition; project-folder plus filter-chain compilation model
scriptEvidence: Go CLI (main.go) driving filter execution; documented `go test ./test` suite

strongIndicators: 37 tagged releases, 106 stars, 22 forks, and 23 contributors
Dedicated documentation site plus a companion standard-library filter repository
Explicit CI/test suite (go test ./test) described in the README
gaps: Source was not opened or copied; facts are README/documentation-level only

implementationFacts.implementationPattern: Add-on compiler: a versioned project folder (source of truth outside com.mojang) is compiled by running a configurable, ordered chain of filters (any language/process) that non-destructively transform RP/BP files as they are copied into the world's development packs
limitations: Distinct build/runtime concern from in-game gameplay capabilities; it is a development-time pipeline tool, not a runtime API
runtimeHooks: Regolith filter chain (any language, external process per filter)

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-09-11 against the public README, root file listing (LICENSE, LICENSE.rtf), and release/contributor history.
Only README-level facts were used; no compiler source code was copied into Hydraulic.
